time_normalization_instructions:
Parse time ranges into ISO 8601 format. Handle various formats:
Year ranges: "1996-2007" start: 1996-01-01T00:00:00Z, end: 2007-12-31T23:59:59Z
Date ranges: "Aug 21, 2017" specific dates
Time ranges: "16:00 UT to 19:00 UT on 2017 August 21" specific times
Unclear: "Unclear" mark as approximate with null dates
Single‐timestamp events set both start and end to that exact ISO instant
Missing date context: "19:02:58–19:10:20 UT" set error: true, error_message: "Cannot determine date - time range lacks date context"
If date information is missing and you cannot determine the date, set error: true with a descriptive error_message NEVER default to Unix epoch (1970-01-01) - this indicates a parsing failure When in doubt about dates, it's better to return an error than to guess incorrectly
Set precision level based on specificity: year, month, day, hour, minute, second
